draft.subject: Re: Checking in on Orchard Labs' setup
draft.body:
Hi Keiko,

Thanks for the quick reply — glad things are going well, and the offer of a walkthrough stands whenever you want it.

If it's useful, I'd happily spend 20 minutes with you this week to get your first project started: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so one real project with a few tasks is usually the quickest way to see whether it fits how Orchard Labs works. Just tell me a time that suits and I'll send an invite.

Best,
Nadia
